passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
passages.text: A Disable person in the age group of 18 to 79 years is eligible under this Scheme.

source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
passages.text: He / She is entitled to receive Rs. 300/- per month from Central Government under this Scheme.

source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
passages.text: He / She also receives Rs 1200/- per month under State sponsored Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana, so total financial assistance of Rs. 1500/- per month is provided.

source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)

source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
passages.text: Under this scheme, Rs. 1500 per month is given to each beneficiary.

source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
passages.text: The applicant can apply at the Collector’s Office / Tehsildar’s Office, Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana Branch / Talathi Office.

source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
passages.text: The applicant should be a resident of Maharashtra.

source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
passages.text: The applicant should be a person with a disability.

source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
passages.text: The percentage of the disability should be 80% or more.

source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
passages.text: The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any other social security scheme.

source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
passages.text: Step 1: The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the Collector Office/Tahsildar/Talathi of your district, and request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the concerned authority.

source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
source.locator: myScheme page; Application Process, Offline, step 1

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
passages.text: Step 2: In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).

source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
source.locator: myScheme page; Application Process, Offline, step 2

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
passages.text: Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the concerned authority.

source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
source.locator: myScheme page; Application Process, Offline, step 3

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
passages.text: Step 4: Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

source.publisher: Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
source.locator: myScheme page; Application Process, Offline, step 4

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Maharashtra)
passages.text: NOTE: Ensure that the application is submitted within the prescribed period, if any.
